prompt.zh-TW: 雲嶺茶莊今年營業活動的現金流量總計 {{money:vars.ocf}}，「支付股息(-)」列是 {{money:vars.dividends}}；年底資產總計 {{money:vars.assets}}，流動負債 {{money:vars.cl}}。依課程 Excel 口徑計算{{term:tm_jbtbky5v|plain}}，以百分比作答。
prompt.en: Cloud Ridge Tea House had net cash from operating activities of {{money:vars.ocf}} this year and its ‘dividends paid (-)’ line shows {{money:vars.dividends}}; at year end total assets are {{money:vars.assets}} and current liabilities {{money:vars.cl}}. Using the course Excel basis, what is the {{term:tm_jbtbky5v|plain}}? Answer as a percentage.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_jbtbky5v}}的分子是營業活動現金扣掉付出去的股利（網站把股利取正值相減），分母是{{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}}減{{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}，也就是非流動資產加上營運資金（流動資產減流動負債）。比率回答「本業留下的現金，有多少比例可以再投入公司」。
explanation.en: The numerator of the {{term:tm_jbtbky5v}} is operating cash less the dividends paid out (the site treats dividends as a positive amount and subtracts it); the denominator is {{term:tm_t7a3s6wb}} less {{term:tm_c2y9b5ex}}, that is, non-current assets plus working capital (current assets less current liabilities). The ratio answers ‘what share of the cash the business keeps can be reinvested’.
